{{Top|leg}}
The '''sun caves''' or '''coral caves''' were a group of [[Cave/Legends|caves]] situated in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fitsay]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. Located under the [[Great Shell Dome]], the caves housed the [[Golden Sun]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] communal intelligence made up of thousands of [[Coral/Legends|coral]] polyps. The native [[Sedrian]]s worshiped Golden Sun, and built a [[Great Shell Dome|dome]] to house the caves.<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>
